extensionDescription.message: Read PDFs, highlight text, and add text boxes. Annotations are written into the PDF file.

toolbarPagesTitle.message: Show or hide the page thumbnail rail.

toolbarNotesTitle.message: Show or hide the annotation rail.

toolbarHighlightTitle.message: Highlight selected text. Keys 1-5 change colour.

toolbarHighlightFreeTitle.message: Drag across the page to draw a highlight. Keys 1-5 change colour.

toolbarTextBoxTitle.message: Drag a box on the page and type inside it.

toolbarSaveTitle.message: Write annotations into the PDF file (Ctrl+S).

toolbarOpenInChromeTitle.message: Open this file in Chrome's built-in PDF viewer.

swatchTitle.message: $NAME$ (key $KEY$). Click to use it, right-click to change this colour.

textColorTitle.message: Colour of the text in a text box.

textSizeTitle.message: Font size of text in a text box, $MIN$ to $MAX$.

zoomReadoutTitle.message: Current zoom level. Opens the list of zoom levels.

pageInputTitle.message: Page being shown. Type a page number and press Enter to go to it.

saveStatusUnsavedTitle.message: These annotations are not in the PDF file yet. Press Ctrl+S to write them.

saveStatusSavingTitle.message: Writing annotations into the PDF file.

saveStatusSavedTitle.message: Every annotation is written into the PDF file.

railEmpty.message: Highlights and text boxes you add will be listed here.

capabilityEncrypted.message: This PDF is encrypted. totoPDF can display it but cannot save changes to it.

capabilityNoText.message: This PDF has no selectable text. Hold and drag across the page to draw a highlight.

saveStillOpening.message: Wait for the document to finish opening, then save.

savePermissionDenied.message: Write permission was denied. Choose the file again to save.

autosaveStopped.message: Automatic saving stopped for this document. Press Ctrl+S to save it. The write failed with: $ERROR$

fileAccessHint.message: Chrome blocks extensions from reading local files until you allow it: open chrome://extensions, find totoPDF, turn on "Allow access to file URLs", then reload this page.

loadingSaving.message: Writing annotations into the PDF file

saveConfirmed.message: Annotations written into the PDF file.

unsavedSwitchWarning.message: This document has unsaved annotations, and opening another document discards them. Cancel, press Ctrl+S to write them into the file, then open the other document.

welcomeIntro.message: totoPDF opens PDFs in its own viewer so you can highlight text and add text boxes. What you add is written into the PDF file itself, as standard PDF annotations, so other readers see it too.

welcomeLocalHeading.message: One step is needed for PDFs on your own computer

welcomeLocalBody.message: Chrome does not let any extension read files from your disk until you allow it, and an extension cannot turn that on for itself. Open totoPDF's extensions page, then turn on "Allow access to file URLs".

welcomeUsageBody.message: Once file access is on, local PDFs open in totoPDF automatically. For any other PDF, right-click it and choose "Open in totoPDF", or click the totoPDF icon in the toolbar while the PDF is open.
